question: Ticket 96a53e6a90c7 says 'Find why cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_an_instrument_runs_under_the_seal.py reds on Windows and fix it so the proof reseals green.', but outline 9.4.8.1 reads "The verdict's instrument run is a seal-grade run, so it runs where the sealer runs (9.4.2.3.3.1), under bubblewrap. A box without bubblewrap (Windows) asks for it and does not run it itself. A bwrap-only tooth reads not-run on such a box, never red; its outcome is the sealer's. - CC" (9.4.8.1 states: 'A box without bubblewrap (bwrap) (Windows) asks for it and does not run it itself. A bwrap-only tooth reads not-run on such a box, never red; its outcome is the sealer's.' Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
